description:
In a multinational company's annual audit process, the audit coordinator initiates the audit process by sending a notification to the regional office.
The regional office prepares financial statements and gathers necessary documents.
Concurrently, the compliance team checks for any regulatory updates that might affect the audit.
Afterward, the regional office submits the documents to the central audit team.
The central audit team reviews the submission.
If discrepancies are found, they request clarifications from the regional office.
The regional office provides the necessary clarifications.
Once all documents are reviewed without issues, the audit team conducts a risk assessment.
The risk assessment includes evaluating financial risks, operational risks, and compliance risks, which can be done in any order but must all be completed.
If high risk is identified, then a detailed investigation is launched.
The investigation includes data analysis, interviews, and, in certain cases, site visits.
After all risks are addressed, the audit team compiles the audit report.
The report is reviewed by the audit director.
The audit director may approve the report or send it back for revisions.
If revisions are required, the audit team updates the report accordingly and resubmits it to be reviewed again by the audit director.
Once approved, the final report is distributed to the executive board and archived.
The entire audit process is then closed.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_AnnualAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual Audit Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AuditRoles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditCoordinator" name="Audit Coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_AuditInitiated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Prep_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Prep_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegulatory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CentralAuditTeam" name="Central Audit Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Review_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancy_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Risk_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinancialRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OperationalRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ComplianceRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Risk_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Investigation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit Director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" name="Audit process initiated">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitiatedToNotification</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send audit notification to regional office">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitiatedToNotification</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotificationToPrepSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Start preparation and compliance check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotificationToPrepSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToPrepare</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToCompliance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareStatements" name="Prepare financial statements and gather documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToPrepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareToPrepJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRegulatory" name="Check regulatory updates affecting the audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToCompliance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ComplianceToPrepJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Join" name="Preparation and compliance check completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareToPrepJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ComplianceToPrepJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepJoinToSubmit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepJoinToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToReviewMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Merge" name="Submission or clarified submission">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToReviewMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClarificationToReviewMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewMergeToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submitted documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewMergeToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToDiscrepancySplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoDiscrepancies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToDiscrepancySplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DiscrepanciesFound</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoDiscrepancies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestClarification" name="Request clarifications from regional office">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DiscrepanciesFound</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestToProvide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideClarification" name="Provide necessary clarifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestToProvide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClarificationToReviewMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Risk_Split" name="Start risk assessments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoDiscrepancies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RiskSplitToFinancial</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RiskSplitToOperational</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RiskSplitToCompliance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FinancialRisk" name="Evaluate financial risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RiskSplitToFinancial</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinancialToRiskJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_OperationalRisk" name="Evaluate operational risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RiskSplitToOperational</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OperationalToRiskJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ComplianceRisk" name="Evaluate compliance risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RiskSplitToCompliance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ComplianceRiskToRiskJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Risk_Join" name="All risk assessments completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinancialToRiskJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OperationalToRiskJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ComplianceRiskToRiskJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RiskJoinToHighRiskSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RiskJoinToHighRiskSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HighRisk</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoHighRisk</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Investigation" name="Detailed investigation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HighRisk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InvestigationToRiskMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Investigation" name="Investigation launched">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InvStartToDataAnalysis</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DataAnalysis" name="Perform data analysis">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InvStartToDataAnalysis</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DataAnalysisToInterviews</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Interviews" name="Conduct interviews">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DataAnalysisToInterviews</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InterviewsToSiteVisitSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" name="Site visit required?" default="Flow_NoSiteVisit">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InterviewsToSiteVisitSplit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SiteVisitRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoSiteVisit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SiteVisit" name="Conduct site visit">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SiteVisitRequired</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SiteVisitToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge" name="Investigation activities completed">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SiteVisitToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoSiteVisit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToInvEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Investigation" name="Investigation completed">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToInvEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvStartToDataAnalysis" sourceRef="StartEvent_Investigation" targetRef="Task_DataAnalysis"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DataAnalysisToInterviews" sourceRef="Task_DataAnalysis" targetRef="Task_Interviews"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewsToSiteVisitSplit" sourceRef="Task_Interviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" targetRef="Task_SiteVisit">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${siteVisitRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSiteVisit" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisit" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToInvEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_Investigation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RiskMerge" name="All risks addressed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InvestigationToRiskMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoHighRisk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RiskMergeToCompile</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RiskMergeToCompile</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompileToReportMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportMerge" name="Report ready for director review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompileToReportMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateToReportMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReportMergeToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReportMergeToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewReportToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Report approved?" default="Flow_RevisionsRequired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewReportToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RevisionsRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update audit report with required revisions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RevisionsRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateToReportMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DistributeReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DistributeToArchive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DistributeToArchive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArchiveToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArchiveToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitiatedToNotification" sourceRef="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotificationToPrepSplit" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPrepare" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCompliance" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToPrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareStatements" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplianceToPrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatory" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepJoinToSubmit" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToReviewMerge" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarificationToReviewMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarification" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewMergeToReview" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDiscrepancySplit" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DiscrepanciesFound" name="Discrepancies found" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestClarification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${discrepanciesFound == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDiscrepancies" name="No discrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Risk_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToProvide" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarification" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToFinancial" sourceRef="Gateway_Risk_Split" targetRef="Task_FinancialRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToOperational" sourceRef="Gateway_Risk_Split" targetRef="Task_OperationalRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToCompliance" sourceRef="Gateway_Risk_Split" targetRef="Task_ComplianceRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinancialToRiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_FinancialRisk" targetRef="Gateway_Risk_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OperationalToRiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_OperationalRisk" targetRef="Gateway_Risk_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplianceRiskToRiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_ComplianceRisk" targetRef="Gateway_Risk_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskJoinToHighRiskSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Risk_Join" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HighRisk" name="High risk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" targetRef="SubProcess_Investigation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${highRiskIdentified == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" name="No high risk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" targetRef="Gateway_RiskMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvestigationToRiskMerge" sourceRef="SubProcess_Investigation" targetRef="Gateway_RiskMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskMergeToCompile" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompileToReportMerge" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateToReportMerge" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportMergeToReview" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewReportToApproval" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReport" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_DistributeReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reportApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisionsRequired" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeToArchive" sourceRef="Task_DistributeReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchiveToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="EndEvent_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
